LESSON: ENTERPRISE PROJECTS ENVIRONMENT

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social 2.1 Harmonious By the end of the sub-strand,  Learners to visit a market
Topic 2.2: Enterprise projects environment

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Enterprise projects environment. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. respond appropriately to  In groups, learners to reflect, share and report strangers in the back their experiences about responding to community strangers

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. respond appropriately to  In groups, learners to reflect, share and report strangers in the back their experiences about responding to community strangers
   In simple words: practise until you can respond appropriately to  In groups, learners to reflect, share and report strangers in the back their experiences about responding to community strangers. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Enterprise projects environment using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Enterprise projects environment in the examples.
2. Explain Enterprise projects environment to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Enterprise projects environment.
4. Show that you can: respond appropriately to  In groups, learners to reflect, share and report strangers in the back their experiences about responding to community strangers

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Enterprise projects environment using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Enterprise projects environment important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Watch a video clip on how they in the community could respond appropriately to strangers b) respond appropriately to
2. In groups, learners to reflect, share and report strangers in the back their experiences about responding to community strangers c) take personal
3. Learners are guided on how to use phone responsibility in keeping when in danger safe to limit risks.
4. Simulate ways of responding appropriately to strangers
5. Find out from parents or guardians appropriate ways of responding to strangers. 121

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. respond appropriately to  In groups, learners to reflect, share and report strangers in the back their experiences about responding to community strangers
